If Padma had gotten $20\%$ more marks in QA and $8\%$ more marks in DI and $7.14\dots\%$ more marks in VA/RC, then she must had gotten $100\%$ marks in all the three sections. questions.q: F(a,b,c,d) = $3a + 2bc + 5c^2d$. If a, b, c and d increases by $65\%$, $32\%$, $25\%$ and $5.6\%$ respectively. What is the percentage change in F?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change]

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, polynomial me agar har ek degree-term barabar percentage se badhe, toh total function bhi utne hi percentage se badhega. Har term ka degree net nikal kar dekh!



Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Term 1: 'a' akela hai, $+65\%$.
Term 2: 'bc'. b ($+32\%$), c ($+25\%$). Net $= 32 + 25 + \frac{32 \times 25}{100} = 57 + 8 = +65\%$.
Term 3: '$c^2d$'. pehle c ka square yani $25+25+6.25 = 56.25\%$. Phir iska d ($+5.6\%$) ke sath: $56.25 + 5.6 + \frac{56.25 \times 5.6}{100} = 61.85 + 3.15 = +65\%$.
Chunki saare independent terms exactly $65\%$ se badh rahe hain, unka addition bhi $65\%$ se hi badhega!

Takeaway: Ye CGL Mains ka trap hai. Calculations mat karo, pattern pakdo.

questions.q: A reduction of $10\%$ in the price of sugar enables a housewife to buy 6.2 kg more for 1116. The reduced price per kg is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio) / Shortcut Trick

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, budget constant hai toh direct amount bachao. $\text{Rs. } 1116$ ka $10\%$ mind me nikal, fir $6.2$ se divide kar de. Final answer wahi milta hai without variable equation.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Sabse tagdi hack batata hu iski! Exam me fraction ya equations likhne ki zaroorat hi nahi hoti isme. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Saved Money} = 10\% \text{ of } 1116 = 111.6 \\ \text{New Price} = \frac{\text{Saved Money}}{\text{Extra Quantity}} \\ = \frac{111.6}{6.2} = 18 \text{ Rs/kg} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial price be $x$. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{1116}{0.9x} - \frac{1116}{x} = 6.2 \\ \frac{1116}{x} \left( \frac{1}{0.9} - 1 \right) = 6.2 \\ \frac{1116}{x} \left( \frac{0.1}{0.9} \right) = 6.2 \implies x = 20 \\ \text{Reduced Price} = 0.9 \times 20 = 18 $$

Exam Takeaway: Price changes me "Saved money = Extra Quantity" rule directly reduced value provide karta hai, jo har aise pattern ko todta hai.

Ninja Formula ComponentCalculation Structure
A. Reduced Price1. $\frac{\text{Discount } \% \times \text{Amount}}{\text{Extra Quantity}}$

questions.q: When a number is increased by 120\% then it becomes 70 less than another number, but if that number is increased by 80\% then it becomes 130 less than that second number. Find the difference of both the numbers.
questions.s: Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedha $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ka farq dekh, aur udhar $130$ aur $70$ ke gap ko pakad. Ek linear equation dimag me ban jani chahiye bina pen uthaye. Language trap me nahi fasna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach - Highly Recommended): $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ke beech ka gap hai $40\%$. Udhar numbers ka gap hai $130 - 70 = 60$. Seedha equate maar: $40\% \equiv 60$. Toh $100\%$ (pehla number) hua $150$. Ab $150$ ka $120\%$ badhayega ($+180$) toh $330$ aayega. Ye dusre number se $70$ kam hai, matlab dusra number $= 330 + 70 = 400$ hai. Dono ka difference pucha hai: $400 - 150 = 250$. Uda diya secondon me! Method 2 (Algebraic Approach - Tera Corrected $2.2x$ & $1.8x$ method): Maan le pehla number $x$ aur dusra $y$ hai. Condition 1: $x$ ko $120\%$ badhaya toh $100\% + 120\% = 220\%$ hua, yani $2.2x$. Equation: $y - 2.2x = 70$ Condition 2: $x$ ko $80\%$ badhaya toh wo $1.8x$ banega. Equation: $y - 1.8x = 130$ Dono ko subtract karne par: $-0.4x = -60 \Rightarrow x = 150$. Isko first equation me rakh: $y - 2.2(150) = 70 \Rightarrow y - 330 = 70 \Rightarrow y = 400$. Difference $= 400 - 150 = 250$. Method 3 (Concept Builder - $100x$ Assumption): Pehla number maan le $100x$. Usme $120\%$ joda toh ban gaya $220x$. Question kehta hai ye dusre number ($y$) se $70$ kam hai, yani $220x = y - 70$. Jab $80\%$ joda toh ban gaya $180x$, jo $y$ se $130$ kam hai, yani $180x = y - 130$. Dono equations ko ghata de, $40x = 60$ aayega, $x = 1.5$ banega. Toh $100x = 150$. $y$ ki value nikalega toh $400$ aayegi. Farq nikal le $400 - 150 = 250$ aayega. Exam Takeaway: Bhai meri ek baat dhyan se sun, agar exam me Method 2 ($2.2x, 1.8x$) ya Method 3 ($100x, y$) laga ke aisi equations likhega, toh time bohot khichega aur selection door chala jayega. SSC CGL aur CDS me time hi sab kuch hai. Aisi word problems ko hawa me udane ke liye humesha Method 1 (Unitary Scaling) ko hi prefer karna. Percentage gap ko value gap ke barabar rakh aur direct answer nikal!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ye kya mazaak chal raha hai exam me? Pen bhi mat uthana isme! Mathematically :- $$ 75\% = \frac{3}{4} \\ 3 \text{ units} = 450 \\ 1 \text{ unit} = 150 \\ 4 \text{ units} = 600 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let total marks be $x$. Student got $75\%$ marks, which is given as $450$. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{75}{100} \times x = 450 \\ \frac{3}{4}x = 450 \\ x = \frac{450 \times 4}{3} = 600 $$

questions.q: If a% of 240 is c and c% of a is 117.6, then the value of a+c is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Linear Equations)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... values thodi un-natural aur decimal lag rahi hain, yahan equations direct likh kar substitutions karna fastest padega rather than assuming numbers.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bacha ke calculation karte hain. Precision and speed dono barkarar! Mathematically :- $$ \frac{a \times 240}{100} = c \implies c = 2.4a \\ \frac{c \times a}{100} = 117.6 \implies ac = 11760 \\ a(2.4a) = 11760 \implies 2.4a^2 = 11760 \\ a^2 = 4900 \implies a = 70 \\ c = 2.4(70) = 168 \\ a + c = 70 + 168 = 238 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): In equations me bache cross multiplication me ulajhte hain aur numbers bade kar dete hain. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{240a}{100} = c \text{ and } \frac{ac}{100} = 117.6 \\ a \left( \frac{240a}{100} \right) = 11760 \text{ (Substitute proper fraction)} \\ a^2 = \frac{11760 \times 100}{240} = 4900 \\ a = 70, c = 168 \implies a+c = 238 $$

Exam Takeaway: Product based conditions me humesha relative value nikal kar seedha quadratic equation form kiya karo.

StepTransformation

Married aadmi nikale toh $5$ ka $40\%$ yani $2$ unit, aur aurtein bhi $2$ unit. Total married $= 4$ unit. Percentage pucha hai toh $\frac{4}{13} \times 100 = 30.76\%$. Approximation laga aur $30.8\%$ tick kar!

questions.q: In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is:
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, yaha numbers actual aur percentages dono me hain (invalid votes aur majority donno values hain). Yahan tu direct 100 base par nahi khel sakta kyuki invalid votes fix fraction me nahi hain. Simple linear equation frame karni padegi!

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Maan le total polled = $100x$. Loser ko mile $42x$. Invalid hain 1400. Toh Valid votes = $100x - 1400$. Winner ko kitne mile? Valid - Loser = $(100x - 1400) - 42x = 58x - 1400$. Majority = Winner - Loser = $(58x - 1400) - 42x = 16x - 1400$. Ye value margin of defeat hai jo 3080 diya hai. $16x = 4480 \implies x = 280$. Total polled $100x = 28000$. Invalid percentage = $\frac{1400}{28000} \times 100 = 5\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar 1400 votes valid hote (suppose kisi ko nahi milte), toh total margin waisa rehta par votes ki counting shift hoti. Aise logic build up complex kar sakte hain. Jab actual figure absolute count (1400) me ho, toh 'x' tera best friend hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Agar percentages ke beech koi fix integer ghusa hua ho, toh Unitary approach (100) fail ho jayegi, $100x$ variable use karna secure hota hai.

Entity BreakdownVotes Assigned
A. Loser1. $42x$
B. Winner2. $58x - 1400$

questions.q: Rate of tax increase by 18%, if net income reduced by 2%. Find initial rate of tax.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 1. CPR

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, jab tax badhta hai toh net income usi absolute value se girti hai. Seedha funda: Tax ka $18\%$ = Net Income ka $2\%$. Ratio 1:9. Total income 10 units. Tax rate $1/10 = 10\%$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Direct equivalence formula.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Tax} \times 18\% = \text{Net Income} \times 2\% \\ \frac{\text{Tax}}{\text{Net Income}} = \frac{2}{18} = \frac{1}{9} \\ \text{Total Income} = 1 + 9 = 10 \text{ units} \\ \text{Tax Rate} = \frac{1}{10} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Basic definitions ko equate karna.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Total Income} = \text{Net Income} + \text{Tax} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} + \Delta \text{Net Income} = 0 \text{ (Total Income is constant)} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} = - \Delta \text{Net Income} \\ T \times \frac{18}{100} = NI \times \frac{2}{100} \\ 18 T = 2 NI \implies NI = 9 T \\ \text{Total Income} = 9 T + T = 10 T \\ \text{Rate} = \frac{T}{10 T} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Ye pattern SSC ka damad hai. Hamesha Tax / (Tax + Net Income) laga aur age badh!

questions.q: After two successive increments, a person's salary became $156.25\%$ of the original salary. If the percentage increase in the second increment was equal to that in the first increment, then what was the percentage of each increment?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, successive me jab barabar increment ho 2 baar toh seedha Compound Interest wala Square Root ($\sqrt{}$) concept lagta hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Salary initial $100\%$ thi ab $156.25\%$ ho gayi. Ratio nikal fraction me: $\frac{156.25}{100} = 1.5625$. Kyunki 2 saal ka identical successive hai, iska square root nikal de! $\sqrt{1.5625} = 1.25$. Yani har saal ka base multiplier $1.25$ tha. Base $1$ pe $0.25$ ki badhotri ka sidha matalab hai ki $25\%$ ka increment tha har stage pe. Ekdum pen free approach! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula se lagayega: $(1 + \frac{r}{100})^2 = 1.5625$. Fir square root karega toh wahi $1 + \frac{r}{100} = 1.25$ aayega aur $r = 25\%$ aayega. Exam Takeaway: Identical successive percentage hamesha powers me deal hota hai. 2 baar toh square root, 3 baar toh cube root.
ConceptOperation
2 Identical SuccessiveSquare Root of Net Multiplier
3 Identical SuccessiveCube Root of Net Multiplier

questions.q: In a village, there are two candidates in an election. $20\%$ of the registered voters did not vote, and 1,792 votes were declared invalid. The winning candidate secured $42\%$ of the TOTAL registered votes and won by 3,584 votes. In the neighboring city of Lucknow, the total registered voters are 3 times that of the village. During an election in Lucknow, 4,400 votes were declared invalid, and the winner secured $58\%$ of the valid votes. What is the difference between the valid votes secured by the winning and losing candidates in Lucknow?
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, lamba question dekh ke darna nahi hai, parts me tod. Village mein Winner ko total ka $42\%$ mila. Loser ko kya mila hoga? Total polled me se invalid aur winner hata de. Baad me Lucknow ka factor nikal lenge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Village Voters} = T \\ \text{Winner (W)} = 42\% T \\ \text{Loser (L)} = (80\% T - 1792) - 42\% T = 38\% T - 1792 \\ W - L = 4\% T + 1792 = 3584 \\ 4\% T = 1792 \implies T = 44800 \\ \text{Lucknow Voters} = 44800 \times 3 = 134400 \\ \text{Lucknow Valid} = 134400 - 4400 = 130000 \\ \text{Lucknow Margin} = (58\% - 42\%) \times 130000 = 16\% \times 130000 = 20800 $$

Exam Takeaway: Bade statements bas exam hall me pressure banane ke liye hote hain, concepts aur direct equations pakde rakh!

questions.q: A man's annual income has increased by $\text{Rs. } 2$ lakhs but the tax on Income that he has to pay has reduced from $20\%$ to $16\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jab Amount same ho, toh Income aur Tax Rate ek dusre ke inversely proportional hote hain! Ekdum direct udana hai ise! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Tax Rate Ratio} = 20:16 = 5:4 \\ \text{Income Ratio} = 4:5 \\ \text{Difference} = 1 \text{ unit} = 2 \text{ lakhs} \\ \text{New Income} = 5 \text{ units} = 10 \text{ lakhs} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial income be $x$ lakh. According to the question, normal equation banegi. Mathematically :- $$ 20\% \times x = 16\% \times (x + 2) \\ 0.20x = 0.16x + 0.32 \\ 0.04x = 0.32 \\ x = 8 \\ \text{New Income} = x + 2 = 10 $$

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me variables ki jagah Ratio inversions lagana time bachata hai jab product constant ho.

questions.q: The income of A is $45\%$ more than that of B. The income of C is $60\%$ less than the sum of the incomes of A and B. The income of D is $20\%$ more than that of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is ₹13,200, then find the income of C.
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, simple base lo. B ko 100x maan. Aur mentally percentage multipliers lagate jao, answer denominator aur multiple format me turant strike karega.

Method 1 (Concept Builder):

Mathematically :-

$$ B = 100x \implies A = 145x \implies (A+B) = 245x \\ C = (100\% - 60\%) \times 245x = 40\% \times 245x = 98x \\ D = 120\% \times 98x = 117.6x \\ D - B = 117.6x - 100x = 17.6x \\ 17.6x = 13200 \implies x = \frac{132000}{176} = 750 \\ C = 98 \times 750 = (100 - 2) \times 750 = 75000 - 1500 = 73500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab denominator me kuch kaatne wala na bache aur numerator me 98 ho, toh 7 ka multiple check karke option bhi mark kar sakte ho.

questions.q: A heavy industrial machine was purchased for 2,00,000. Its value depreciated by b% in the first year and then appreciated by a% in the second year due to an upgrade. Both a and b are natural numbers. If the value of the machine after the second year was more than its original purchase price, and a - b = 8 find the lowest possible depreciated value of the machine at the end of the first year.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) / Number Theory

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Ye sawal purely CAT level trap hai jo SSC Mains me aa sakta hai. Net change positive hona chahiye, yaani $a - b - \frac{ab}{100} > 0$. $a - b = 8$ diya hai. So, $8 - \frac{ab}{100} > 0 \implies ab < 800$. Humein first year ke baad ki value lowest chahiye, yaani depreciation 'b' maximum hona chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $ab < 800$ and $a = b + 8$. Put kar: $b(b+8) < 800$. Ab options se hint le ya hit & trial kar. Agar $b=20$ rakha toh $20 \times 28 = 560$ (aur bada ho sakta hai). Agar $b=25$ rakha toh $25 \times 33 = 825$ (800 cross kar gaya, fail). Agar $b=24$ rakha toh $24 \times 32 = 768 < 800$. Perfect! Max possible natural number $b = 24$. Toh 1st year depreciation 24% hai. Value = $200000 \times (1 - 0.24) = 152000$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Mathematically quadratic inequality solve karni padegi: $b^2 + 8b - 800 < 0$. Roots are around 24.something. Since b is a natural number, largest integer $b = 24$.

Future Exam Takeaway: Absolute hardest trap! Hamesha Net successive change formula me inequalities laga kar extreme case pakdo.

questions.q: A tech company operates a data center with 15 Alpha-servers and 6 Beta-servers. The daily data handling capacity of an Alpha-server is 20% of a Beta-server's capacity, resulting in a fixed total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes. Due to a software upgrade, the capacity of each Beta-server is increased by 12%. What percentage reduction in the number of Alpha-servers is required to maintain the exact same total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes? (Given that the capacity of Alpha-servers and the number of Beta-servers remain unchanged).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A \times B + C \times D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Bandwidth = Servers $\times$ Capacity per Server hai. Overall limit fix rakhni hai (225 TB). Beta-servers ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya wahi hai, iska matlab unka total data contribution exactly 12% se jump marega. Data cap ko overflow se bachane ke liye, Alpha-servers ko exactly wahi extra data cut karna padega. Time waste kiye bina directly initial bandwidth ratio nikal! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha product ratio nikal kar deviation ko balance kar de, exact data ki zarurat hi nahi hai. Mathematically :-
$\text{Capacity Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$
$\text{Bandwidth Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = (15 \times 1) : (6 \times 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$

questions.q: Varun gave $60\%$ of the money he had to his wife. He also gave $20\%$ of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of $\text{Rs. } 9,600$ was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, tree method ya successive line dono se chalega! Par language me bacha kar chalna hai: '20% to each of his three children' bole toh $20 \times 3 = 60\%$ of remaining kharch hua hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial amount ko 100 maan le. 60 wife ko de diya, bacha 40. Ab is 40 ka $60\%$ (20% x 3 bachhe) usne de diya. $40$ ka $60\% = 24$. Question ke hisab se $6.4$ unit = 9600. Pucha total (100 unit) hai. $\frac{9600}{6.4} \times 100 = 1500 \times 100 = 1,50,000$. Done! Yani $x \times 0.4 \times 0.4 \times 0.4 = 9600$. $x \times 0.064 = 9600 \implies x = 1,50,000$. Exam Takeaway: Examiner 'each' word daal kar hamesha trap karta hai, usay nazarandaaz mat karna.

questions_hin.q_hi: A reduction of $10\%$ in the price of sugar enables a housewife to buy 6.2 kg more for 1116. The reduced price per kg is?

Mathematically :- $$ \text{Saved Money} = 10\% \text{ of } 1116 = 111.6 \\ \text{New Price} = \frac{\text{Saved Money}}{\text{Extra Quantity}} \\ = \frac{111.6}{6.2} = 18 \text{ Rs/kg} $$

questions_hin.q_hi: When a number is increased by 120\% then it becomes 70 less than another number, but if that number is increased by 80\% then it becomes 130 less than that second number. Find the difference of both the numbers.
questions_hin.s_hi: Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedha $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ka farq dekh, aur udhar $130$ aur $70$ ke gap ko pakad. Ek linear equation dimag me ban jani chahiye bina pen uthaye. Language trap me nahi fasna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach - Highly Recommended): $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ke beech ka gap hai $40\%$. Udhar numbers ka gap hai $130 - 70 = 60$. Seedha equate maar: $40\% \equiv 60$. Toh $100\%$ (pehla number) hua $150$. Ab $150$ ka $120\%$ badhayega ($+180$) toh $330$ aayega. Ye dusre number se $70$ kam hai, matlab dusra number $= 330 + 70 = 400$ hai. Dono ka difference pucha hai: $400 - 150 = 250$. Uda diya secondon me! Method 2 (Algebraic Approach - Tera Corrected $2.2x$ & $1.8x$ method): Maan le pehla number $x$ aur dusra $y$ hai. Condition 1: $x$ ko $120\%$ badhaya toh $100\% + 120\% = 220\%$ hua, yani $2.2x$. Equation: $y - 2.2x = 70$ Condition 2: $x$ ko $80\%$ badhaya toh wo $1.8x$ banega. Equation: $y - 1.8x = 130$ Dono ko subtract karne par: $-0.4x = -60 \Rightarrow x = 150$. Isko first equation me rakh: $y - 2.2(150) = 70 \Rightarrow y - 330 = 70 \Rightarrow y = 400$. Difference $= 400 - 150 = 250$. Method 3 (Concept Builder - $100x$ Assumption): Pehla number maan le $100x$. Usme $120\%$ joda toh ban gaya $220x$. Question kehta hai ye dusre number ($y$) se $70$ kam hai, yani $220x = y - 70$. Jab $80\%$ joda toh ban gaya $180x$, jo $y$ se $130$ kam hai, yani $180x = y - 130$. Dono equations ko ghata de, $40x = 60$ aayega, $x = 1.5$ banega. Toh $100x = 150$. $y$ ki value nikalega toh $400$ aayegi. Farq nikal le $400 - 150 = 250$ aayega. Exam Takeaway: Bhai meri ek baat dhyan se sun, agar exam me Method 2 ($2.2x, 1.8x$) ya Method 3 ($100x, y$) laga ke aisi equations likhega, toh time bohot khichega aur selection door chala jayega. SSC CGL aur CDS me time hi sab kuch hai. Aisi word problems ko hawa me udane ke liye humesha Method 1 (Unitary Scaling) ko hi prefer karna. Percentage gap ko value gap ke barabar rakh aur direct answer nikal!

questions_hin.q_hi: If a% of 240 is c and c% of a is 117.6, then the value of a+c is:

Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Linear Equations)

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bacha ke calculation karte hain. Precision and speed dono barkarar! Mathematically :- $$ \frac{a \times 240}{100} = c \implies c = 2.4a \\ \frac{c \times a}{100} = 117.6 \implies ac = 11760 \\ a(2.4a) = 11760 \implies 2.4a^2 = 11760 \\ a^2 = 4900 \implies a = 70 \\ c = 2.4(70) = 168 \\ a + c = 70 + 168 = 238 $$

Mathematically :- $$ \frac{240a}{100} = c \text{ and } \frac{ac}{100} = 117.6 \\ a \left( \frac{240a}{100} \right) = 11760 \text{ (Substitute proper fraction)} \\ a^2 = \frac{11760 \times 100}{240} = 4900 \\ a = 70, c = 168 \implies a+c = 238 $$

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is:
questions_hin.s_hi:

questions_hin.q_hi: Rate of tax increase by 18%, if net income reduced by 2%. Find initial rate of tax.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 1. CPR

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, jab tax badhta hai toh net income usi absolute value se girti hai. Seedha funda: Tax ka $18\%$ = Net Income ka $2\%$. Ratio 1:9. Total income 10 units. Tax rate $1/10 = 10\%$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Direct equivalence formula.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Tax} \times 18\% = \text{Net Income} \times 2\% \\ \frac{\text{Tax}}{\text{Net Income}} = \frac{2}{18} = \frac{1}{9} \\ \text{Total Income} = 1 + 9 = 10 \text{ units} \\ \text{Tax Rate} = \frac{1}{10} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Basic definitions ko equate karna.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Total Income} = \text{Net Income} + \text{Tax} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} + \Delta \text{Net Income} = 0 \text{ (Total Income is constant)} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} = - \Delta \text{Net Income} \\ T \times \frac{18}{100} = NI \times \frac{2}{100} \\ 18 T = 2 NI \implies NI = 9 T \\ \text{Total Income} = 9 T + T = 10 T \\ \text{Rate} = \frac{T}{10 T} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Ye pattern SSC ka damad hai. Hamesha Tax / (Tax + Net Income) laga aur age badh!

questions_hin.q_hi: After two successive increments, a person's salary became $156.25\%$ of the original salary. If the percentage increase in the second increment was equal to that in the first increment, then what was the percentage of each increment?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, successive me jab barabar increment ho 2 baar toh seedha Compound Interest wala Square Root ($\sqrt{}$) concept lagta hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Salary initial $100\%$ thi ab $156.25\%$ ho gayi. Ratio nikal fraction me: $\frac{156.25}{100} = 1.5625$. Kyunki 2 saal ka identical successive hai, iska square root nikal de! $\sqrt{1.5625} = 1.25$. Yani har saal ka base multiplier $1.25$ tha. questions_hin.q_hi: In a village, there are two candidates in an election. $20\%$ of the registered voters did not vote, and 1,792 votes were declared invalid. The winning candidate secured $42\%$ of the TOTAL registered votes and won by 3,584 votes. In the neighboring city of Lucknow, the total registered voters are 3 times that of the village. During an election in Lucknow, 4,400 votes were declared invalid, and the winner secured $58\%$ of the valid votes. What is the difference between the valid votes secured by the winning and losing candidates in Lucknow?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, lamba question dekh ke darna nahi hai, parts me tod. Village mein Winner ko total ka $42\%$ mila. Loser ko kya mila hoga? Total polled me se invalid aur winner hata de. Baad me Lucknow ka factor nikal lenge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Village Voters} = T \\ \text{Winner (W)} = 42\% T \\ \text{Loser (L)} = (80\% T - 1792) - 42\% T = 38\% T - 1792 \\ W - L = 4\% T + 1792 = 3584 \\ 4\% T = 1792 \implies T = 44800 \\ \text{Lucknow Voters} = 44800 \times 3 = 134400 \\ \text{Lucknow Valid} = 134400 - 4400 = 130000 \\ \text{Lucknow Margin} = (58\% - 42\%) \times 130000 = 16\% \times 130000 = 20800 $$

Exam Takeaway: Bade statements bas exam hall me pressure banane ke liye hote hain, concepts aur direct equations pakde rakh!

questions_hin.q_hi: A man's annual income has increased by $\text{Rs. } 2$ lakhs but the tax on Income that he has to pay has reduced from $20\%$ to $16\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bol raha hai tax amount same hai. Income $\times$ Rate = Tax. Jab Tax constant hota hai, Income aur Rate inverse ratio me aa jate hain, seedha ud jayega ratio se!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jab Amount same ho, toh Income aur Tax Rate ek dusre ke inversely proportional hote hain! Ekdum direct udana hai ise! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Tax Rate Ratio} = 20:16 = 5:4 \\ \text{Income Ratio} = 4:5 \\ \text{Difference} = 1 \text{ unit} = 2 \text{ lakhs} \\ \text{New Income} = 5 \text{ units} = 10 \text{ lakhs} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial income be $x$ lakh. According to the question, normal equation banegi. Mathematically :- $$ 20\% \times x = 16\% \times (x + 2) \\ 0.20x = 0.16x + 0.32 \\ 0.04x = 0.32 \\ x = 8 \\ \text{New Income} = x + 2 = 10 $$

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me variables ki jagah Ratio inversions lagana time bachata hai jab product constant ho.

A. Tax Rate Ratio1. $5:4$
B. Income Ratio2. $4:5$

questions_hin.q_hi: The income of A is $45\%$ more than that of B. The income of C is $60\%$ less than the sum of the incomes of A and B. The income of D is $20\%$ more than that of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is ₹13,200, then find the income of C.
questions_hin.s_hi:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, simple base lo. B ko 100x maan. Aur mentally percentage multipliers lagate jao, answer denominator aur multiple format me turant strike karega.

Method 1 (Concept Builder):

Mathematically :-

$$ B = 100x \implies A = 145x \implies (A+B) = 245x \\ C = (100\% - 60\%) \times 245x = 40\% \times 245x = 98x \\ D = 120\% \times 98x = 117.6x \\ D - B = 117.6x - 100x = 17.6x \\ 17.6x = 13200 \implies x = \frac{132000}{176} = 750 \\ C = 98 \times 750 = (100 - 2) \times 750 = 75000 - 1500 = 73500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab denominator me kuch kaatne wala na bache aur numerator me 98 ho, toh 7 ka multiple check karke option bhi mark kar sakte ho.

questions_hin.q_hi: A heavy industrial machine was purchased for 2,00,000. Its value depreciated by b% in the first year and then appreciated by a% in the second year due to an upgrade. Both a and b are natural numbers. If the value of the machine after the second year was more than its original purchase price, and a - b = 8 find the lowest possible depreciated value of the machine at the end of the first year.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) / Number Theory

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Ye sawal purely CAT level trap hai jo SSC Mains me aa sakta hai. Net change positive hona chahiye, yaani $a - b - \frac{ab}{100} > 0$. $a - b = 8$ diya hai. So, $8 - \frac{ab}{100} > 0 \implies ab < 800$. Humein first year ke baad ki value lowest chahiye, yaani depreciation 'b' maximum hona chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $ab < 800$ and $a = b + 8$. Put kar: $b(b+8) < 800$. Ab options se hint le ya hit & trial kar. Agar $b=20$ rakha toh $20 \times 28 = 560$ (aur bada ho sakta hai). Agar $b=25$ rakha toh $25 \times 33 = 825$ (800 cross kar gaya, fail). Agar $b=24$ rakha toh $24 \times 32 = 768 < 800$. Perfect! Max possible natural number $b = 24$. Toh 1st year depreciation 24% hai. Value = $200000 \times (1 - 0.24) = 152000$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Mathematically quadratic inequality solve karni padegi: $b^2 + 8b - 800 < 0$. Roots are around 24.something. Since b is a natural number, largest integer $b = 24$.

Future Exam Takeaway: Absolute hardest trap! Hamesha Net successive change formula me inequalities laga kar extreme case pakdo.

questions_hin.q_hi: A tech company operates a data center with 15 Alpha-servers and 6 Beta-servers. The daily data handling capacity of an Alpha-server is 20% of a Beta-server's capacity, resulting in a fixed total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes. Due to a software upgrade, the capacity of each Beta-server is increased by 12%. What percentage reduction in the number of Alpha-servers is required to maintain the exact same total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes? (Given that the capacity of Alpha-servers and the number of Beta-servers remain unchanged).
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A \times B + C \times D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Bandwidth = Servers $\times$ Capacity per Server hai. Overall limit fix rakhni hai (225 TB). Beta-servers ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya wahi hai, iska matlab unka total data contribution exactly 12% se jump marega. Data cap ko overflow se bachane ke liye, Alpha-servers ko exactly wahi extra data cut karna padega. Time waste kiye bina directly initial bandwidth ratio nikal! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha product ratio nikal kar deviation ko balance kar de, exact data ki zarurat hi nahi hai. Mathematically :-
$\text{Capacity Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$
$\text{Bandwidth Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = (15 \times 1) : (6 \times 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$
$\text{Extra bandwidth by Beta} = 12\% \text{ of } 2 = +0.24 \text{ units}$
$\text{Loss required by Alpha} = -0.24 \text{ units}$
$\% \text{ reduction in Alpha} = \frac{0.24}{1} \times 100 = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ maan kar total bandwidth equate kar, naya target nikal aur percentage check kar. Mathematically :-
$\text{Let Capacity Alpha} = 1x, \text{Capacity Beta} = 5x$
$\text{Total Bandwidth} = 15(1x) + 6(5x) = 45x$
$45x = 225 \implies x = 5$
$\text{Initial Bandwidth Alpha} = 15 \times 5 = 75$
$\text{Initial Bandwidth Beta} = 6 \times 25 = 150$
$\text{New Capacity Beta} = 25 \times 1.12 = 28$
$\text{New Bandwidth Beta} = 6 \times 28 = 168$
$\text{Required Bandwidth Alpha} = 225 - 168 = 57$
$\text{New Count of Alpha Servers} = \frac{57}{5} = 11.4 \text{ servers}$
$\% \text{ Reduction} = \frac{15 - 11.4}{15} \times 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the ultimate ranker hack. Jab variable $A \times B$ ke form me ho aur ek dimension constant rakhi jaye, toh directly final product ke ratio par base value set karo aur shift ko transfer kar do. Absolute base data (225) ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
StepZero-Sum Hack Action
1. Base RatioFind final aggregate ratio ($\alpha : \beta = 1 : 2$)
2. Find DeviationCalculate exact units gained ($12\%$ of $2 = +0.24$)
3. Balance & ScaleShift the same loss over Alpha's base ($-0.24 / 1 = 24\%$)

questions_hin.q_hi: Varun gave $60\%$ of the money he had to his wife. He also gave $20\%$ of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of $\text{Rs. } 9,600$ was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?:
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, tree method ya successive line dono se chalega! Par language me bacha kar chalna hai: '20% to each of his three children' bole toh $20 \times 3 = 60\%$ of remaining kharch hua hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial amount ko 100 maan le. 60 wife ko de diya, bacha 40. Ab is 40 ka $60\%$ (20% x 3 bachhe) usne de diya. $40$ ka $60\% = 24$. Ab bacha $40 - 24 = 16$. Is 16 me se 'Three-fifth' (yani $\frac{3}{5}$) usne miscellaneous me uda diya. Toh bacha kitna? $\frac{2}{5}$ hissa. $16$ ka $\frac{2}{5} = 6.4$ unit bacha. Question ke hisab se $6.4$ unit = 9600. Pucha total (100 unit) hai. $\frac{9600}{6.4} \times 100 = 1500 \times 100 = 1,50,000$. Done! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Straight chain fraction bana le: $x \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 3/5) = 9600$. Yani $x \times 0.4 \times 0.4 \times 0.4 = 9600$. $x \times 0.064 = 9600 \implies x = 1,50,000$. Exam Takeaway: Examiner 'each' word daal kar hamesha trap karta hai, usay nazarandaaz mat karna.

questions_hin.q_hi: A cuboid tank has dimensions: length = 25 cm, breadth = 20 cm, and height = 16 cm. If the length is increased by 10%, the breadth is decreased by 20%, and the height is increased by 10%, what is the percentage change in volume?
questions_hin.s_hi:

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Base dimensions (25, 20, 16) diye hain sirf darane aur time waste karne ke liye! Percentage change pucha hai, original values se koi matlab nahi. Net successive lagao.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $+10\%, -20\%, +10\%$. Pehle 10 aur -20 ka net nikalo: $10 - 20 - \frac{200}{100} = -12\%$. Ab is -12% ka bache hue +10% ke sath lagao: $-12 + 10 - \frac{120}{100} = -2 - 1.2 = -3.2\%$. questions_hin.q_hi: The town has a present population of 2,40,000. Every year the population increases by $12\%$ and decreases by $7\%$ due to migration. What will be the population after 3 years? (CHSL TIER 1- 19/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aate hain 12 aur jaate hain 7. Net change har saal ka $5\%$ increase hai. 5% = $1/20$, matlab ratio 21/20 banega. 21 matlab 3 ka multiple aur 9 ka DS!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $240000 \times (21/20)^3$. Yaha 21 cube hai matlab 9 ka multiple aayega fix hai. Options ka Digital Sum (C9) nikal. Option A: $2+7+7+8+3+0 = 27 \implies 9$. Seedha answer hai. Baaki options check bhi mat kar.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Net} = +12\% - 7\% = +5\%$
$A = 240000 \times (\frac{21}{20})^3$
$\text{DS}(21^3) = 9$
$\text{Options DS}: A=9$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Cube solve kar. $9261 / 8000$. Fir 240000 se kaat ke multiply kar, poori mazdoori hai.

Mathematically :-
$A = 240000 \times \frac{9261}{8000}$
$A = 30 \times 9261 = 277830$

questions_hin.q_hi: In an exam, (x+50)% of the students passed in English, (x+30)% of the students passed in Science and x% of the students passed in both subjects. If $15\%$ of the students failed in both subjects, then find the value of x.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Set Theory logic

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, variables cancel out ho jate hain Set theory ke formula mein. Passed log $85\%$ hain. $(x+50) + (x+30) - x = 85$ bas yahi simple mind calc karni thi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Venn diagram ki simple set equation lagani hai. Options dekho aur tick maro! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Pass } \% = 100\% - 15\% = 85\% \\ P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) \\ 85 = (x + 50) + (x + 30) - x \\ 85 = x + 80 \\ x = 5 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram draw karke parts break karna. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Eng Only} = (x + 50) - x = 50 \\ \text{Sci Only} = (x + 30) - x = 30 \\ \text{Both Pass} = x, \text{Fail} = 15 \\ 50 + 30 + x + 15 = 100 \\ x + 95 = 100 \implies x = 5 $$

Exam Takeaway: Set theory union formula is the fastest way jab overlapping sets ki percentage variables me chal rahi ho.

Set Theory RelationApplication Data
A. $\text{P(A} \cup \text{B)} = \text{Total} - \text{Failed}$1. $100 - 15 = 85$
